# Dark Hub v1.0 Feature Documentation

---

## Tab 1: Combat

### Groupbox: Targeting

* Aimbot Control (Toggle | Default Key: E, Hold Mode):

Automatically directs camera aim toward the closest visible hostile player within the FOV radius.

* Adaptive Target Bone: Prioritizes the player's Head. If targeting headless anomalous SCP entities (such as SCP-173 or SCP-939), the targeting engine automatically falls back to the center of mass (HumanoidRootPart or Torso).

* Team Check (Toggle):

Prevents the aimbot from locking onto allied units, scientists, security guards, and friendly personnel, ensuring only hostile entities are targeted.

* GOC Disposition (Dropdown: Automatic / Friendly / Hostile):

Determines how the system handles members of the Global Occult Coalition (GOC):

* Automatic: Dynamically detects whether the native game engine marked the player with a friendly highlight or if an allied relation exists in the active round.

* Friendly: Forces the system to treat all GOC players as allies (ignored by aimbot, green ESP).

* Hostile: Forces the system to treat all GOC players as enemies regardless of game state.

* Visibility Check (Toggle):

Multi-pass visibility raycast engine. Validates direct line-of-sight while explicitly ignoring transparent materials such as glass panes, observation windows, wire fences, and forcefields, allowing targets behind containment windows to be tracked.

* FOV Radius (Slider: 30 to 600):

Defines the pixel radius around the screen center/mouse cursor within which targets will be acquired.

* Smoothness (Slider: 1 to 15):

Adjusts the camera interpolation speed. A setting of 1 delivers an instant snap, while higher values provide smooth, humanized tracking.

* Display FOV (Toggle + ColorPicker):

Renders an on-screen circle representing the active aimbot acquisition zone, with a fully customizable color picker.

---

### Groupbox: Weapon Mechanics

* Zero Recoil (Toggle):

Injects directly into the engine state tables (u4.recoilControl = 1 and internal statistics cache) to completely eliminate vertical recoil, horizontal drift, and weapon kick impulses across all weapons.

* Zero Spread (Toggle):

Locks weapon spread multiplier to zero (u4.spreadControl = 1), ensuring all fired projectiles land precisely on the crosshair center regardless of travel distance.

* No Screen Shake (Toggle):

Zeros out the ViewPunch camera offset applied by the engine whenever a firearm is discharged.

* Rapid Fire (Toggle):

Significantly increases the cyclic fire rate of all equipped firearms.

* Fire Rate Multiplier (Slider: 1.2x to 8.0x):

Controls the specific velocity multiplier applied to the weapon's native fire rate.

* Full Auto (Toggle):

Converts semi-automatic and burst firearms (such as pistols, sniper rifles, and shotguns) into fully automatic weapons upon holding the trigger.

* Run & Gun (Toggle):

Permits unrestricted weapon firing while sprinting at maximum velocity. Bypasses the engine check that slows movement down to base walkspeed and suppresses the first-person downward sprint animation on the viewmodel.

---
